title: narcissus serotinus var. aequilimbus
intro: Narcissus serotinus var. aequilimbus, commonly known as the autumn-flowering narcissus, is a variant of the serotinus species within the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including its antiviral, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential remedy for certain conditions. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus serotinus var. aequilimbus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
